generator_fix.rule: Every right group but the last is rounded from its share (halves round up, floor(x+0.5)), and the last group takes the remainder. The groups therefore sum exactly to the centre height minus the 28px dock foot. Under FIT-H2 a collapsed group is 26 and the open groups split the freed height by the same rule.
generator_fix.why: The mocks already use this rule (mock_raster, mock_vector and mock_design: gs[-1] = h - sum(others)), so the table and the mocks cannot disagree. The leftover pixel goes to the last group, which opens with Layers, a list panel, and FIT-L2 gives extra height to list panels. Explicit half-up rounding matches Rust f64::round for positive values, so a host computing the split gets the same pixels; Python round() rounds halves to even. Largest-remainder rounding would also partition exactly, but it can move the spare pixel between groups and would then differ from the mocks.
